description.value:
Frequency at will

Requirement Marked quarry hasn't noticed you, or you've lost track of it via a Ghostwalker technique

Deals an extra 3d8 precision damage (4d8 at Undying tier) — well beyond what being off-guard alone would grant.

cinderfall.incomplete: Also depends on "a Ghostwalker technique" (Ghostwalker's own signature is itself unencoded — see above), compounding the block. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
